dependencies.basis: Definitions of employment, unemployment and labour underutilization in the Labour Force Survey follow the resolutions of the International Conferences of Labour Statisticians (ICLS), including the 1982 resolution and the 2013 resolution on labour underutilization.
dependencies.evidence_quote: これらの考え方は，国際労働機関（ILO）の1982 年の第13 回国際労働統計家会議（ICLS）における決議に基づいている。... 2013 年の第19 回国際労働統計家会議（ICLS）における決議では，「未活用労働」という新たな概念が取り入れられ

dependencies.basis: The Flow of Funds Accounts are compiled in accordance with the international standard for the System of National Accounts; the series was aligned with 2008 SNA recommendations in conjunction with the national-accounts benchmark revision.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The FFA are compiled in accordance with the international standard for the System of National Accounts and are conducive to international comparisons of financial structures. ... The FFA will be revised once again in the first half of 2016 with the implementation of the new statistical standard (2008SNA).

dependencies.basis: Weights for the Index of Industrial Production (and related mining/manufacturing indicators) are derived from value-added data in the Economic Census (National Business Survey / Census of Establishments) and related annual surveys.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources of weights: The weights for the base year were calculated for each industry and item based on the total added value of mining, manufacturing, electricity and gas in that year. The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP).

dependencies.basis: Industrial Production Index weights also incorporate Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP) value-added data for the base year and subsequent updates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product(GRDP). The weights after the base year have been calculated for each industry and item using the annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and GRDP.

dependencies.basis: Imputed rent weights and certain structure-related elements of the CPI draw on the National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth (in addition to the Family Income and Expenditure Survey).
dependencies.evidence_quote: In the actual index calculation, the imputed rent, estimated by the National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth (a fundamental statistical survey based on the Statistics Act)

dependencies.basis: The Economic Census (both Business Frame and Business Activity components) is conducted as a Fundamental Statistical Survey under the Statistics Act (Act No. 53 of 2007).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The purpose of the Economic Census for Business Activity is to clarify the business activities of establishments and enterprises in Japan on both a national and regional level... (conducted under the framework of official statistics governed by the Statistics Act)

dependencies.basis: The Monthly Survey of Mining and Manufacturing (and the Industrial Production Index derived from it) uses the Economic Census / National Business Survey as a primary source for base-year weights and structural benchmarks.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources of weights: The weights for the base year were calculated for each industry and item based on the total added value of mining, manufacturing, electricity and gas in that year. The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product(GRDP).

dependencies.basis: The Labour Force Survey sampling frame is based on Population Census enumeration districts; benchmark population estimates for ratio estimation are derived from Population Census-based population estimates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The sampling method is a stratified two-stage sampling using the EDs (enumeration districts) of the Population Census as the first-stage sampling units... The estimation method for the monthly figures of whole Japan is the ratio estimation with a benchmark of the population by age... estimated from the Population Estimates based Population Census
